cards.name: Early Recruitment
cards.text: Before the game begins, the player going first chooses one of the four factions. They then select from the trade deck a card of that faction that costs 1 Trade, and add it to their personal deck. The player going second repeats this process, choosing two of the remaining factions. Finally, the player going first repeats the process for the remaining faction.

cards.name: Entrenched Loyalties

cards.name: Flare Mining

cards.name: Fleeting Opportunities
cards.text: At the start of each player’s turn, scrap the card in the trade row furthest from the trade deck, slide all the other cards over one space, then add the top card of the trade deck to the trade row.

cards.name: Frantic Preparations

cards.name: Frontier Expedition
cards.text: Before the game begins, each player replaces two of the Scouts in their personal deck with Explorers.

cards.name: Maximum Warp
cards.text: At the start of each player’s turn, that player draws a card.

cards.name: Picking Sides
cards.text: Before the game begins, the player going first chooses one of the four factions.
